finding: Detailed decision rules in the old finite protocols measure rubric following and can mask independent candidate benefit.
historical-decision-boundary: R23 and R17 ties do not justify promotion; R21 regression retains rejection. Do not regrade historical scores or infer causes from expired raw answers.
required-next-protocol: Outcome-neutral syntax without decision mappings or skill-loading hints
Separate calibrated semantic truth and syntax checks before a fresh baseline
Small predeclared source/record contrasts and near-negative or held-out controls
Defer ceiling baseline; reject no semantic improvement, negative regression, hard violation or incomplete evidence
checkpoint-boundary: Model sees current bytes and recorded before hashes. Original-byte provenance is checker-owned unless original bytes are supplied to the model.
corpus-boundary: Only scope expansion is a confirmed incident; the reviewed new capabilities primarily protect proposed architectural contracts.
evidence-source: evolution_contract_architecture bounded methodology audit in this task
